charts.question: Flexible reserve starts and stops
charts.supported_finding: Each policy pays for the same reserve time. Frequent changes carry additional organizational cost.
charts.interpretation_boundary: Historical outcomes describe observed calls. Staffing schedules, patience past the censoring point, operator flexibility and policy-dependent waits are simulated. The five-hour morning replay begins with an empty queue.

charts.supported_finding: 30% more arrivals in each sampled day's busiest period; each switch costs 0.25 percentage-point equivalents.
